question: On Agreeing to the Resolution — Providing for consideration of the bills H.R. 9576 and H.R. 10326, providing for consideration of the joint resolutions H.J. Res. 210 and H.J. Res. 213, and providing for consideration of the Senate amendments to H.R. 5334 (H RES 1530)
plain_language: Adopting this rule sets the terms for the fraud-division bill, the fraud-data bill, two California emissions disapprovals, and the Senate changes to the Russia-sanctions bill. A Yea adopts the rule. A Nay rejects it.
